verdict.rationale: CONTRIBUTING.md documents a dev-mode workflow that symlinks your checkout into .claude/skills/ so Claude Code reads skills you edit directly. This shows gstack supports contributor-side skill authoring, and the many SKILL.md files show the format exists. The pack does not show a documented template or spec for SKILL.md frontmatter, so authors would apparently have to infer the format from existing skills, which is exactly what the story wants to avoid. missing for 10: a documented SKILL.md template, a frontmatter field reference (name/description), a step-by-step guide for creating a new skill, and independent confirmation that authoring works without copying existing skills.
